component.name: Levitate
component.summary: Control your Linux desktop by moving your Android phone

description.p: Levitate pairs an Android air mouse with a local Linux companion using a QR code and an encrypted connection on your Wi-Fi network.
Move the pointer, scroll, switch workspaces, and use on-screen mouse buttons. Desktop input uses the Linux uinput device on Wayland and X11.
This dependency-aware AppImage requires the host Python, GTK, PyGObject, cryptography, qrcode, Pillow, and uinput access. Tray integration uses the host AppIndicator library.
